svg.text: Hair silhouette vocabulary · direction proof v5
REVIEW ONLY · rigid head-group art · current one-row body air and y−5 cell reframe retained
crop · sweep · bob · knot · tail · cloud
rigid head group · west remains mirrored
all bodies + all heads · 40/48 · four facings
A · same head, same body: current analogs vs. stronger silhouette anchors
Portrait shows the construction; 40 px black south/east figures decide whether it changes the gameplay silhouette.
Several current styles differ internally but share the same outer cap.
Outer mass first; strand texture remains a later surface pass.
B · multiplicative check: one Sweep across all six head hulls
The hair supplies directional asymmetry; the lower face should continue to identify Round, Broad, Long, Block, Point, and Lantern.
C · one static system: six hair anchors paired with six heads and six bodies
Hair is independent presentation: none of these pairings assigns a body, gender, job, or temperament.
Direction read: vary lateral reach, vertical interruption, rear mass, and edge rhythm; keep every style rigid with the existing head group.
